brief: Mother Edith was born on 10 March 1861. She was chosen from the Deaconess Community of St Andrew, London, to answer the call of Bishop Churchill Julius of Christchurch for a sister to work in his diocese. She arrived in Christchurch in 1893 to find a small group of dedicated probationer deaconesses ready to form a community. Originally called “The Sisters of Bethany”, they became “The Community of the Sacred Name” in 1911. Mother Edith’s outstanding characteristics were compassion, humility, fearlessness and a loving concern for all. For her nothing was too difficult. She died on 25 May 1922.
